## Findings
- [ ] **[WARN][Coverage] Patch coverage 78.1% below the 80% patch bar**
  - **Status quo:** 66 of 301 changed executable lines (v0.4.2..HEAD) uncovered, concentrated in `cmd/symbrain/cmd_doctor_handshake.go`, `cmd/symbrain/cmd_doctor_print.go`, `cmd/symbrain/cmd_profile_print.go` (print/handshake helpers split out in the command-file refactor), plus defensive branches in `internal/broker/server.go:156-158`, `internal/gateway/server.go:64-66`, `internal/harness/diff.go:100-111`.
  - **Likely cause:** The doctor/profile command split moved formatting helpers into new files whose table/output branches are only partially exercised; the harness diff and broker/gateway lines are OOM-guard / error-injection branches.
  - **Proposed solution:** Add table-driven tests for the moved print helpers and error-path tests for the guard branches.
  - **Handoff:** `/test-coverage` → `/02-gh-plan --from-coverage <path>` → `/03-gh-go`

- [ ] **[WARN][Docs] AGENTS.md project-structure section is stale**
  - **Status quo:** `AGENTS.md:59-72` lists 10 `internal/` packages; the repo has 15 — `internal/config`, `internal/output`, `internal/security`, `internal/sync` and `internal/xdg` are missing from the structure listing.
  - **Likely cause:** Structure section not updated when the packages were added in earlier cycles.
  - **Proposed solution:** Add the five missing package entries with one-line responsibilities.
  - **Handoff:** `/03-gh-go`

- [ ] **[WARN][Tests] 10 errcheck findings from local golangci-lint**
  - **Status quo:** `golangci-lint run ./...` reports 10 unchecked error returns: `internal/audit/log.go:180,182` (rotation renames), `internal/harness/ordered_map.go:182,221,231,329` (JSON writer), and 4 in `internal/audit/log_test.go`. CI has no lint job, so HEAD CI is green regardless; `make lint` masks the failure by falling back to `go vet` when golangci-lint exits non-zero.
  - **Likely cause:** Deliberately unchecked writer/rotation calls from earlier cycles; no CI enforcement.
  - **Proposed solution:** Check or explicitly ignore the error returns in production code; fix the Makefile lint fallback so lint failures are not silently downgraded to `go vet`.
  - **Handoff:** `/03-gh-go`
